articles.title: Binance bets on becoming a crypto 'super app' as stablecoins reshape growth
articles.snippet: Shunyet Jan, Binance’s head of spot trading and derivatives, said the exchange is focusing more on payments and financial services than on trading alone as it drives the next phase of its expansion.

articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid's rise threatens Circle's USDC economics
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid's deal with Circle and Coinbase creates a "prisoner's dilemma" that puts pressure on earnings from the dollar-pegged stablecoin.

articles.title: Japan’s biggest card network taps Circle to bring stablecoins to 40 million merchants
articles.snippet: JCB and Circle will explore using USDC for cross-border payments and merchant transactions as Japan ramps up efforts to bring stablecoins into everyday commerce.

articles.title: JCB signs Circle MOU to test stablecoin payments in Japan
articles.snippet: The companies will explore using USDC for JCB’s cross-border treasury operations and merchant payments in Japan as regulated stablecoin adoption gains momentum.

articles.title: ABA, state banking groups push back on CLARITY Act stablecoin yield provisions
articles.snippet: ABA and state banking associations published a joint letter calling for more detail on the CLARITY Act’s stablecoin yield provisions, ahead of the bill’s House hearing on Friday.
